rv.q: The performer’s verbal flexibility and perfect pacing make Man To Man compelling theatre.
Really brave, engaging and emotive performance from Tilda Swinton.

Reuniting with director Stephen Unwin to reprise her role in Manfred Karge’s solo play at the Royal Court, the Hollywood star is a mesmerising stage presence, effortlessly shifting between the play’s female and male personas.

cn.t: Swinton's return to the stage after nearly 40 years proves compelling in this multi-character monologue about a woman surviving 1930s Germany by impersonating her dead husband, with critics praising her chameleonic performance and perfect pacing.
